nodes.label: CSS-var semantic colour tokens (COLORS)
nodes.rationale: Raw hex values in JSX made dark/light theming impossible; Recharts accepts CSS var strings.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Critical Bug Fixes
nodes.rationale: Hash-scroll interval cleanup, abort-signal race, Math.min empty array, invalid lap fallback.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Performance Optimizations
nodes.rationale: Null driver slots skip fetch under Rules of Hooks; O(n) position bucketing; memoization.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Semantic timing tower table, labelled search, skip link, required aria-label on ToolbarButton.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Visual / UI Improvements
nodes.rationale: CSS-var design tokens via COLORS so theming is possible; load missing Orbitron font.

nodes.label: Phase 5 Error Handling & Resilience
nodes.rationale: Per-tab ErrorBoundary, refetch retry UI, URL param range validation, cache namespacing by sessionKey.

nodes.label: Phase 6 Code Quality & Housekeeping
nodes.rationale: Named constants, useDriverData hook, exportChart util, DriverContext to remove prop drilling.

nodes.label: Phase 7 Architecture Refactor
nodes.rationale: Container/Presenter split enables UI testing without live API; single useDashboard entry; ref-counted abort.

nodes.label: BetCast translation principles
nodes.rationale: Reuse parent wordmark, neutral page, thin rules instead of card outlines, native mobile selection, quiet utilities.

nodes.label: F1Stories design tokens (dark #181a1c / light #f2eee4, accent #ff826b / #a82e1c)
nodes.rationale: Taken from local f1StoriesPage editorial.css/home.css so Telemetry reads as a sibling of the publication.

nodes.label: Grouped analysis navigation (Performance / Race / Context)
nodes.rationale: Ten views grouped; desktop underline + aria-current, mobile native select with optgroups, no swipe-only rail.

nodes.label: Light/dark theme (warm paper, not inversion)
nodes.rationale: Themes keep URL precedence and localStorage persistence; status/tyre/sector tokens get darker light variants.

nodes.norm_label: f1 stories. / telemetry masthead with tools disclosure

nodes.label: Unboxed shared Panel / chart treatment
nodes.rationale: Heading + explanation + top rule without filled boxes; neutral horizontal grids, wrapped legends, compact tooltips.

nodes.label: Codex Improvement Prompt (8 phases)
nodes.rationale: Phased plan main<-develop<-feature/*; P0 bugs first, then a11y/visual/errors, perf/quality, architecture/testing.

nodes.label: Container + Presenter split

nodes.label: GitHub Pages Deployment (/f1-telemetry-dashboard/ base)
nodes.rationale: vite.config.ts base path required for Pages; generated dist/ must never be committed to main.

nodes.label: npm run ci validation script
nodes.rationale: Local equivalent of the GitHub Actions validation path: lint (fails on warnings), typecheck, tests, build.

nodes.label: CI Workflow (verify job)
nodes.rationale: Runs npm ci + npm run ci on every PR to main and all pushes except gh-pages, keeping main green before merge.

nodes.label: Deploy to GitHub Pages Workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds with npm run ci and uploads dist/ as a Pages artifact on push to main; concurrency group 'pages' cancels in-progress deploys.

nodes.label: Project graphify usage rules (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return scoped subgraphs, much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds graph once per commit via AST only; no background process, editor-agnostic. Docs/images ignored.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion (Step 0)
nodes.rationale: CLI matcher is literal case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms, so questions must be translated into graph vocabulary first.

nodes.label: build_merge replace-on-re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); drops re-extracted source files before merge so stale nodes do not survive (#1344).

nodes.label: Part C merge AST + semantic extraction
nodes.norm_label: part c merge ast + semantic extraction

nodes.label: Fast path: query existing graph.json
nodes.rationale: Skip detect/extract when graph already built and the request is a natural-language question; saves cost.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent edges (use AMBIGUOUS), always show token cost, show raw cohesion scores, warn on >5000-node HTML viz.

nodes.label: Manifest stamping of semantic files
nodes.rationale: Only stamp semantic files that produced output so failed chunks are re-queued on next --update (#2015, #1948).

nodes.label: Part B parallel semantic subagent extraction
nodes.norm_label: part b parallel semantic subagent extraction

nodes.label: #479 shrink-guard on graph.json export
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write when new graph is smaller than existing, so an empty extraction never clobbers a good graph.

nodes.label: Part A structural AST extraction
nodes.rationale: Code is covered deterministically by AST, so only content files go to semantic subagents (#1392).
